title: Heart Face Shape: Features, Hair, Glasses & Makeup Guide
summary: Learn how to identify a heart face shape and explore hairstyle, glasses, makeup, and styling ideas for a broader forehead and tapered chin.
body_markdown:
### What are the main features of a heart face shape?


Heart face shapes are commonly broader across the forehead or upper cheekbone area and taper toward a narrower jaw and a softly pointed or tapered chin.


### How can I tell if I have a heart face shape?


Compare the upper and lower portions of your face in a front-facing photo or mirror. If your forehead or upper face appears wider than your jawline and your face narrows toward the chin, you may have heart-face traits. Use our[face shape test guide](https://www.perfectcorp.com/business/blog/general/face-shape-test) to compare all common categories.


### What hairstyles work with a heart face shape?


Many people explore chin-length cuts, lobs, waves, layers, curtain fringe, side-swept bangs, sleek updos, and short cuts. The best direction depends on hair texture, density, maintenance, and the visual effect you want to create.


### What glasses work with a heart face shape?


Rounded, oval, rimless, upswept, and subtly wider-lower-rim frames can create different visual effects. Comfort, lens size, bridge fit, prescription needs, and personal style should guide the final choice.


### Can AI identify a heart face shape?


A photo-based AI tool can compare visible facial proportions with common face-shape categories. Results can be affected by lighting, image angle, hair, expression, and the natural overlap between categories, so use them as a style reference.
